headword: {長期休暇|ちょうききゅうか}

definitions.explanation: A prolonged period away from work or school, typically lasting a week or more.

examples.japanese: {長期休暇|ちょうききゅうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}りたい→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I want to take a long vacation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{長期休暇|ちょうききゅうか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}→海外旅行：24321_kaigairyokou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}している→計画する：20998_keikakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm planning a trip abroad during summer's long vacation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧{長期休暇|ちょうききゅうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}する→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Under the company's system, you can apply for extended leave once a year.

notes:
Refers to any vacation or leave period significantly longer than usual. In a workplace context, it often means taking a week or more off consecutively, which is uncommon in many Japanese companies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長期休暇|ちょうききゅうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ — to take a long vacation
- {長期休暇|ちょうききゅうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}する→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧ — to apply for extended leave
- {長期休暇|ちょうききゅうか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ — to go on extended leave
- {長期休暇|ちょうききゅうか}{中|ちゅう} — during extended leave

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}→有給休暇：06996_yuukyuukyuuka⟧ — paid leave (specific to employment)
- ⟦{連休|れんきゅう}→連休：07587_renkyuu⟧ — consecutive holidays (usually 2–5 days around national holidays)
- ⟦{休職|きゅうしょく}→休職：18305_kyuushoku⟧ — leave of absence from work (often for health or personal reasons)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Taking long vacations can be difficult in Japan due to workplace culture. Many workers feel pressure not to take extended time off ({有休|ゆうきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧にくい). The government has promoted initiatives like "Premium Friday" to encourage more time off.
